summary: Grupo Cibest S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing changes in the composition of its Risk Committee. The Board of Directors approved new members for the Risk Committee; other board committees remain unchanged. This is a routine corporate governance update regarding committee assignments, not a special situation event. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes in the sense of a forced departure.
